wood.name: Wood
wood.desc: Sturdy branches. The basis of most crafting.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Heavy, rust-red ore from the old mines.

mana_crystal.name: Mana Crystal
mana_crystal.desc: Said to be a tear of the fallen star. It hums faintly in your hand.

slime_gel.name: Slime Gel
slime_gel.desc: Sticky and surprisingly tough once dried.

wooden_sword.name: Wooden Sword
wooden_sword.desc: A practice sword. Better than bare fists.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.desc: A proper blade, heavy and true.

apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
apprentice_staff.desc: Channels small fire bolts. Fire can light things, too.

crystal_staff.name: Crystal Staff
crystal_staff.desc: A mana crystal set in carved wood. Its bolts burn bright.

leather_tunic.name: Gel-Cured Tunic
leather_tunic.desc: Cloth hardened with slime gel. Smells a little.

iron_mail.name: Iron Mail
iron_mail.desc: Rings of iron. Heavy, but you'll feel safe.

lucky_charm.name: Lina's Lucky Charm
lucky_charm.desc: A pebble on a string. Lina swears it's lucky.

mana_charm.name: Mana Charm
mana_charm.desc: A crystal shard bound in iron wire.

dust_courage.name: Dust of Courage
dust_courage.desc: Glittering red dust. Breathing it in steadies your heart. (+1 Courage)

dust_empathy.name: Dust of Empathy
dust_empathy.desc: Soft blue dust that makes the world feel closer. (+1 Empathy)

dust_humbleness.name: Dust of Humility
dust_humbleness.desc: Plain grey dust. Strangely calming. (+1 Humbleness)

dust_kindness.name: Dust of Kindness
dust_kindness.desc: Warm golden dust that smells of bread. (+1 Kindness)
